{{Top|italics=1}}
The '''''Vensenor''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that housed the [[Vensenor Flight Academy/Legends|Vensenor Flight Academy]] on [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]].

==History==
The vessel was one of several ''Venator''s used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to host mobile flight schools for Imperial pilots. The [[Vensenor Flight Academy/Legends|Vensenor Flight Academy]], a branch of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], subsequently became well-known and earned prestige among pilots.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
